name: nicloudai
description: Privacy-first clinical summary assistant browser extension

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts
scripts.build:smoke: tsc -b && vite build --config vite.smoke.config.ts && vite build --config vite.smoke.content.config.ts && node scripts/verify-smoke-build.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run version:check && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run security:scan
